ranked.headline: Computational frameworks inferring regulatory and spatial structure from omics data
ranked.summary: Recent methods extend single-cell and spatial omics inference to causal networks, cross-species atlas matching, and joint multimodal profiling.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and relational features combined for drug, protein and peptide prediction
ranked.summary: Multi-source feature fusion and graph architectures are being evaluated across drug-target, binding-site and peptide prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale and community models link microbial genes and genomes to host outcomes
ranked.summary: Population-scale microbial genome collections and metagenomic tools now resolve plasmid hosts, sex, and probiotic effects directly from sequence data.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomic profiling maps tumor states and microenvironment dependencies
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell methods now infer tumor states, microenvironment links, and gene expression from plasma and atlases at scale.

ranked.headline: Sequence language models for RNA, DNA, and molecules are adding structured objectives
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply joint-embedding objectives, state-space fusion, and pretrained encoders to RNA, DNA, and molecular sequence prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Community curation and multi-species annotation reshape eukaryotic gene model accuracy
ranked.summary: Manual curation and multi-species annotation now quantify and correct gene model errors before comparative genomic analyses are run.

ranked.headline: Metrics and baselines for single-cell perturbation response models are under scrutiny
ranked.summary: Widely used metrics and simple baselines can misrepresent perturbation models, motivating validation of foundation-model embeddings and attention readouts.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models for peptide design and binding prediction face generalization tests
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply protein language models, diffusion, and co-folding to peptide design, binding affinity, and conformation selection.

ranked.headline: Zero-shot models miss epistatic effects while language models track viral evolution
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks expose where zero-shot protein models fail on epistasis, while new generative models target antibody and viral evolution.

ranked.headline: Directed, time-varying and critical brain dynamics as candidate connectivity markers
ranked.summary: Directed, time-varying, and criticality-linked measures are being quantified as candidate markers across MEG, fMRI, LFP, dMRI, and mouse models.

ranked.headline: Computational tools extract quantitative structure from biological images and profiles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply shape descriptors, cell painting pipelines, and virtual microscopy to quantify tissue and cell morphology at scale.

ranked.headline: Inferring unseen diversity and mixed abundances from surveillance-scale microbial data
ranked.summary: Surveillance-scale studies now estimate unseen phage species, resolve mixed variant abundances, and test cheaper alternatives to whole-genome sequencing.

ranked.headline: Physical models predict mechanical readouts of cell state and tissue organization
ranked.summary: Explicit mechanical models now generate testable predictions for EMT junction states, nuclear mechanics, and corneal epithelial stratification.

ranked.headline: Haplotype, path and repeat representations supplant single fixed reference coordinates
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved assemblies, pangenomes and STR panels now extend analyses beyond single fixed-reference coordinates.

ranked.headline: Composable CLI and browser tools now expose alignment, phenotype and genotyping data
ranked.summary: Command-line and interactive interfaces lower the effort needed to move from raw genomic outputs to interpretable views.

ranked.headline: Learned models compress and classify genomic sequences at scale
ranked.summary: Long-context DNA models, pangenome compression, and k-mer classifiers now target speed and scalability on large genomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of cancer genome function from somatic mutation data
ranked.summary: Somatic mutation catalogs spanning hundreds to over 210,000 patients now support mutation-resolved functional inference across tumor genomes.

ranked.headline: Supervised models predict biological properties from sequence, omics and cell-line data
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence embeddings and transfer learning are paired with alternative learners to predict peptide, microbial, and patient outcomes.

ranked.headline: Computational prioritization of candidate genes and pathways in liver disease and lupus
ranked.summary: Public transcriptomic, genetic, and pathway resources are now combined with multi-omics, MR, and flux modeling to nominate candidates.

ranked.headline: Protein language models and structural search scale functional sequence classification
ranked.summary: Growing protein and microbiome sequence collections require classifiers that scale linearly while retaining functional and taxonomic resolution.

ranked.headline: Genomic Context Shapes Two-Hit Loss, Aneuploidy, and Radiation-Induced Instability
ranked.summary: Allele-resolved tumor data, yeast karyotype modeling, and irradiated genome profiling quantify structural and karyotypic change across dose and time.

ranked.headline: Speed-oriented heuristics and parallelization accelerate alignment and homology search
ranked.summary: Several recent tools report large speedups over existing methods, from up to 5-fold for partial order alignment to up to 900-fold for local alignment.

ranked.headline: Graph learning infers unmeasured biological interactions from multimodal representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair graph neural networks with foundation-model embeddings and multimodal omics to predict interactions without direct measurement.

ranked.headline: Single-molecule methods gain explicit statistical inference and accessible software tools
ranked.summary: Between 19 and 23 February 2026, preprints and publications bundled single-molecule data analysis with explicit statistical inference in usable tools.

ranked.headline: Neural networks infer volumes, tilt images and atomic coordinates from cryo-EM density
ranked.summary: Learned models are now applied directly to experimental cryo-EM and cryo-ET density for reconstruction, missing-wedge completion and atomic modeling.

ranked.headline: Simulation recovers structural and mechanical properties of biomolecular assemblies
ranked.summary: Simulation and design pipelines are now applied across phase separation, membrane remodeling, capsid mechanics, and disordered sequence patterning.

ranked.headline: LLMs and AI agents automate curation of heterogeneous biological datasets
ranked.summary: Open-weight LLMs and multi-model agents now match or exceed keyword and human extraction for biological metadata and meta-analysis data.

ranked.headline: ML and statistical models linking genetic variants to traits, disease genes and clinical…
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether variant-to-phenotype inference holds across ancestries and how it prioritizes Mendelian disease genes.

ranked.headline: Bacterial blight lineages track rice dispersal; k-mer models split pre/post-Omicron Delta
ranked.summary: Population-scale and alignment-free genomic analyses of three pathogens are linking evolutionary history and sequence features to dispersal and variant state.

ranked.headline: Quantum and graph neural models address molecular design and committor prediction
ranked.summary: Four items from February 2026 pair quantum-annealing and photonic solvers with neural models for molecular, protein, and transition-rate prediction.

ranked.headline: Non-alchemical binding free energies and synthesizability-aware virtual screening
ranked.summary: Recent items extend ligand screening toward absolute binding free energy, synthesizable chemical space, and unified GPU docking platforms.

ranked.headline: Acquisition-aware and high-throughput software for proteomics and top-down MS analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication pair acquisition-aware DIA modeling and glycopeptide search with repository-scale spectral analysis.

ranked.headline: Protonation and channel asymmetry govern permeation and membrane penetration in MD
ranked.summary: Simulations now resolve charge state and asymmetry as molecular determinants of fluoride permeation and polymyxin membrane penetration.

ranked.headline: Stochastic reaction network models of gene expression and cell-free systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply stochastic and mass-action reaction network frameworks to predict protein responses, fit models, and design experiments.

ranked.headline: Noncoding variants and epigenomic elements linked to disease loci and ageing biology
ranked.summary: GWAS-anchored chromatin capture and genome-scale CpG conservation catalogs now connect noncoding variation to regulatory targets and ageing-linked loci.

ranked.headline: Simulators now encode HLA-restricted immune responses in viral and repertoire sequences
ranked.summary: Host HLA and immune variation is now explicit in simulators of repertoires, within-host viral evolution, and sequencing reads.

ranked.headline: Diffusion models for single-cell expression generation and perturbation response
ranked.summary: Diffusion-based generative models are now applied to single-cell gene counts and perturbation responses, with direct benchmarking against scVI.

ranked.headline: Minimal models tie stochastic variability to synaptic, circadian and mechanical control
ranked.summary: Explicit energy, homeostatic, and feedback constraints yield analytical or simulated predictions for variability in three distinct biological systems.
